title: Category Theory
description: Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

puzzle.goal: In the category of finite sets, an arrow into C from a product A × B (or a disjoint union with D) is the same as choosing an element of C independently for every point of the source. Count the arrows from (A × B) + D into C as nested products over the points, using cardinalities |X|.
puzzle.name: Exponential law in Set (currying and coproducts: C^(A×B+D) ≅ (C^B)^A × C^D)
puzzle.form: prod ( x , 1 , abs ( A ) , prod ( y , 1 , abs ( B ) , abs ( C ) ) ) * prod ( z , 1 , abs ( D ) , abs ( C ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the number of morphisms (A × B) + D → C for |A| = 2, |B| = 3, |C| = 2, |D| = 2.
puzzle.method: A function is a choice of image for every point; the points of A × B are pairs, so the choices nest, and the points of a disjoint union split into two independent blocks.
